slot.brief: Long solenoid with given turns per length and current; find B inside, then force on a small current element placed inside.

stem: A long solenoid has $250$ turns per metre and carries a current of $4$ A. A small current element of length $10$ cm carrying a current of $5$ A is placed inside the solenoid perpendicular to its axis. The magnetic force on the element is (Take $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}$ T m A$^{-1}$)
working: $B = \mu_0 n I = 4\pi\times10^{-7}\times 250\times 4 = 4\pi\times10^{-4}$ T. $F = I' L B \sin 90^\circ = 5 \times 0.1 \times 4\pi\times10^{-4} = 2\pi\times10^{-4}$ N.
solution:
The magnetic field inside a long solenoid is $B=\mu_0 nI$.
$$B=(4\pi\times10^{-7})(250)(4)=4\pi\times10^{-4}\text{ T}$$
Since the current element is perpendicular to the field, $F=I'LB=5(0.1)(4\pi\times10^{-4})=2\pi\times10^{-4}\text{ N}$. \\(B)
